reason: iPad: 'Timeline offset did not decrease enough during downward drag inside expanded extension text (baseline=7670, last=7821, minimumDelta=24)', a deterministic +151 pt flip, the same bug this entry first recorded at +183. It fails the same way on the UIKit harness host that replaced the SwiftUI one, so the host is not the cause; only the viewport geometry moved.

iPad only: fails and passes on rerun in three separate gates, including one with no launch reuse, so it is a flake of its own and not a leak from a neighbour. It fails in under 0.3 s: the test reads the pane pill's position before the layout settles. The test waits for its own layout instead of racing it after the release.
